meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症细胞系的基因依赖与药物敏感性数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究癌症基因依赖或寻找药物靶点。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer cell line gene dependency and drug sensitivity data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are studying cancer gene dependencies or identifying drug targets.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询癌症细胞系的基因依赖分数（CRISPR Chronos）、药物敏感性数据和基因效应图谱，用于识别癌症特异性弱点、合成致死相互作用和验证肿瘤药物靶点。
howto.when: 当用户询问某个基因在特定癌症类型中是否必需、寻找合成致死搭档或分析药物敏感性时触发。

say.text: 查询 KRAS 基因在肺癌细胞系中的依赖分数。
say.note: 返回 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系中的 Chronos 分数。

say.text: 分析 BRCA1 突变细胞系中哪些基因更必需。
say.note: 进行合成致死筛选，返回显著更必需的基因列表。

say.text: 下载 CRISPRGeneEffect.csv 并加载数据。
say.note: 指导用户下载并加载 DepMap 数据文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles from the Cancer Dependency Map, for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about gene essentiality in a specific cancer type, seeks synthetic lethal partners, or analyzes drug sensitivity.

say_en.text: Query KRAS dependency scores in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores for KRAS in lung cancer lines.

say_en.text: Analyze which genes are more essential in BRCA1-mutant cell lines.
say_en.note: Performs synthetic lethality screen, returns significantly more essential genes.

say_en.text: Download CRISPRGeneEffect.csv and load the data.
say_en.note: Guides user to download and load DepMap data files.
